events.summary: Baseline review of the project-maintained public-domain lyrics example: package integrity, capability descriptor, no-network permission surface, bundled historical sample corpus, provenance/rights notes and deterministic tests were checked for 0.1.0.
limitations: This is a deliberately tiny developer corpus, not a general lyrics catalogue.
Historical public-domain status can vary by jurisdiction and edition; broader lyrics integrations need their own source/rights review.
Runtime process isolation is not a complete operating-system sandbox.
